claim: Paclitaxel is a taxane diterpenoid, and GSE266934 includes HCC1143 single-cell libraries exposed to 1 nM paclitaxel or 0.1% DMSO for 24 or 72 hours.
limitation: This chemical exposure experiment is not genetic Perturb-seq.

claim: After the prespecified cell QC, 1,106 and 788 cells remained in the 24-hour DMSO and paclitaxel libraries; 787 and 513 remained at 72 hours.
limitation: These are filtered cells from one library per arm, not independent replicates.

claim: The treated-minus-control median interferon marker score was +0.218 at 24 hours and +0.510 at 72 hours; the selected cell-cycle score was -0.251 and -0.049, respectively.
limitation: Scores summarize prespecified markers and are descriptive; they are not pathway activity estimates or statistical tests.

claim: Marker-level CPM ratios are heterogeneous: at both time points CCNB1 and UBE2C are higher in the paclitaxel library, whereas MKI67, TOP2A, and CENPF are lower.
limitation: Pooled-library CPM can shift with cell composition, survival, and library effects.

claim: This four-library design has one library per treatment and time point, so it cannot establish biological reproducibility, cross-context transfer, or target dependence.
limitation: The conclusion concerns evidence available from this particular design.

claim: Repeat the time-matched comparison across independent culture preparations, include a second dose and another terpenoid, and add a replicated target perturbation before testing target dependence.
limitation: This experiment has not yet been performed.
